feeds.title: Cocktail Revolution
feeds.description: Articles on street-style fashion, events, lifestyle, trending and more. Cocktail Revolution finds the best street-style fashion in Melbourne, Sydney, Adelaide, Perth and other places in Australia. We're a diverse group of Australian creatives and contributors led by Stacey Pallaras. Cocktail Revolution started in 2012 in response to the lack of coverage of diverse Australian faces by the mainstream media. Our version of diversity includes all genders, body shapes, abilities and of course all ethnicities.

feeds.description: Glamour's fashion-focused gift guide provides readers with a curated selection of stylish and trendy gift ideas that align with the latest in fashion. Each gift suggestion is selected with the modern, fashion-conscious recipient in mind.
